subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should maintainers accept this grouped set of executable action updates after exact-head provenance and workflow verification?
rationale: Several updated actions mint tokens, use repository secrets, publish images, upload security results, or execute Codex agents, so ordinary green tests alone do not settle the trust-boundary choice.

options.title: Verify And Merge
options.body: Confirm every action SHA and upstream behavior, rebase the branch, and require successful checks on the exact final head.

options.title: Split Privileged Updates
options.body: Separate token, registry, CodeQL, release, and Codex action bumps into narrower independently reviewed PRs.

options.title: Pause The Batch
options.body: Keep the grouped update unmerged until provenance or exact-head CI gaps are resolved.

recommendation.title: Verify And Merge
recommendation.body: Confirm every action SHA and upstream behavior, rebase the branch, and require successful checks on the exact final head.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release-workflow history and explicit repository ownership make this the best available decision owner.
